notes: A bounded official-API translation of the native-green 102-assertion HLA_EVOKED matrix. With undefined Query GALT, the adapter FOM selects enabled or disabled Non Regulated Grant. Each run checks both empty and queued timestamped-interaction FQR cases. The grant's actual time, optimistic logical time, callback order, and post-grant Query Logical Time are observed through public APIs. Installed-package C++ primary/contract passed focused CTest and direct execution with both adapter FOM switch settings (out/mgw/fqr-undefined-galt-nrg-enabled-final-20261021.json and disabled-final-20261021.json). Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR. The page-202 l107-29 candidate is crosswalked to the §8.13 Flush Queue Grant result under RL-349, not the erroneously exported §8.13.3 preconditions. HLA_IMMEDIATE, Java provider runtime, other transport topologies, interoperability, and conformance remain unverified.
